summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — this is a plan only)  ### What I found from reading the code (no changes made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite. Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, **I could not find an obvious wiring bug**:  - Every watchlist route requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, resolves it to a real `user_id`, and scopes every query (`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. - `login()` looks up the user **by email** (not creating a new row
